## The claim

At least one published allele - reported in ClinVar as pathogenic or likely pathogenic, or carrying at least one publication in LitVar - is present in this child at heterozygous or homozygous-alternate multiplicity in a gene that step 4 ranks in its top 20.

**Prediction if true.** The catalogue join against results.it2_kmer_genotypes (origin clinvar) and against the LitVar publication counts of the child own alleles returns at least one row whose gene is in the step-4 top 20 and whose k-mer call is het or hom-alt.

**What would refute it.** No published allele of any step-4 top-20 gene is present in the child: every such allele is hom-ref or no-call. The leading pair would then be novel on both sides, and the knowledge route would contribute no allele-level corroboration.
